purpose: Implement one shared executable support-envelope law so platform/architecture target policy, exact acceptance evidence, legacy acceptance, experimentation and named known breaks remain mechanically distinct before APP-01 packaging or customer support claims exist.

lineage.outcome: N0TE can truthfully distinguish which macOS, Windows and Linux targets are required from which exact targets have actually earned acceptance evidence; extended reach remains visible without substituting for or blocking required core targets.
lineage.capability: Executable support policy, acceptance evidence and customer-mode blocker projection

n0te2_dependencies: PLATFORM-00A canonical OS/architecture identity and target tiers
legacy_rejections: OS marketing version raises the floor automatically

completion_proof: default architecture policy contains exactly six CORE peer targets: macOS arm64/x86_64, Windows x86_64/arm64, Linux x86_64/arm64
extended reach remains separate: Windows x86_32 plus Linux x86_32/armv7/riscv64
all CORE targets begin UNVERIFIED and block customer-mode readiness until exact ACCEPTED or LEGACY_ACCEPTED evidence exists
accepting one target removes only its exact fingerprint blocker
LEGACY_ACCEPTED requires an explicit upstream limitation and still preserves that limitation in status
KNOWN_BREAK requires a named reason plus evidence and remains blocking for CORE
EXTENDED failures/findings never block or satisfy a CORE target
evidence referencing a target outside the envelope or duplicate/conflicting evidence for one target is rejected
canonical CORE targets cannot be silently downgraded to EXTENDED
runtime OS/architecture aliases reuse PLATFORM-00A normalization and converge to one exact target
scope tags create exact distro/package/hardware subtargets while tag ordering/duplicates do not change identity
OS version policy participates in exact target identity but the support layer performs no version-name heuristic
model exposes no generic supported boolean shortcut; target/status ordering is deterministic and reads are pure
next_selection_rule: After PLATFORM-00C evidence, audit remaining PLATFORM-00 foundation gaps against REQ-SCOPE-149/150/151/153. Keep AUDIO-02 plugin hosting and real PLATFORM-01/02/03 acceptance downstream; globally compare any true shared platform gap against DAW-00 and OPS-04 rather than extending support.py by adjacency.
